name: Google Sheets
tagline: Read your spreadsheets, fill them in, and keep them up to date.
summary: Read and edit the user's Google Sheets, given a link: values, formulas, rows and columns. Adds to a sheet freely; overwrites or deletes what is already there only after the user approves.
can: Read a spreadsheet you give it a link to
Overwrite or delete what is already there, only after you approve it
